scenes.text: The landlord said the flat above mine had been empty for eleven years.
scenes.art_prompt: a dim apartment stairwell with one warm light left on, unsettling

scenes.text: Every night at 2:14, I heard a chair slide back. One scrape, then nothing.
scenes.art_prompt: a single wooden chair lit by a bare bulb in an empty room, long shadow

scenes.text: I asked the neighbour across the hall. She went quiet, then asked which stairs I used.
scenes.art_prompt: a narrow hallway with numbered doors fading into darkness, uneasy

scenes.text: There are no stairs above my floor. The building is four storeys. I live on the top.
scenes.art_prompt: an exterior of a four storey building at night, one window lit above the roofline

scenes.text: That night the scraping came from my own ceiling. Closer than a ceiling should be.
scenes.art_prompt: a bedroom ceiling with a faint crack of light above it, tense

scenes.text: Follow Quiet Horror Files for the next one.
scenes.art_prompt: a dark empty apartment building under a cold moon, final wide shot
